Written by attestqa from its run record; each case is automated by the Playwright test named beside it. Results of each run are in the comments. A case's ID is the story and its design item (SCRUM-18-D1); in the feature file and the spec it is the tag pair @story:SCRUM-18 @design:D1.
Test cases
SCRUM-18-D1 · covers AC-1 · functional / equivalence-partitioning

Scenario not written yet. Given search term matches part of a product name (e.g. 'apple'); search term matches part of a product description; all returned products contain the term in name or description; products not matching the term are absent from results — expected: Only products whose name or description contains the search term are listed; products that do not match are not shown
SCRUM-18-D2 · covers AC-2 · functional / state-transition

Scenario not written yet. Given user enters a search term and submits; results page is now displayed — expected: The search results are shown (product list is filtered); the page displays the searched term so the user can see what was used
SCRUM-18-D3 · covers AC-3 · functional / equivalence-partitioning

Scenario not written yet. Given search term that matches no product (e.g. 'xyzzy123notaproduct'); results area shows a 'nothing found' message rather than an empty page — expected: A message indicating no products were found is displayed; the page is not blank
SCRUM-18-D4 · covers story · accessibility / checklist-based

Scenario not written yet. Given axe-core scan of the search results page with a valid search term applied; rules: wcag2a, wcag2aa; scope: the search results content area — expected: No axe-core violations (violations.map(v => v.id).sort() equals [])
Not tested, and why

rows: SCRUM-28 is about order tracking authorization — any authenticated or unauthenticated user can view any order by number. This does not touch product search behaviour and is not relevant to SCRUM-18.
SCRUM-12 is about session token surviving logout — a session management issue. Product search does not depend on authentication and is unrelated to SCRUM-18.
Both open bugs (SCRUM-28 and SCRUM-12) are Active but unrelated to this story's search behaviour. No Resolved bugs exist to confirm. There is nothing to confirm here.
SCRUM-18 covers unauthenticated product search. The story and its context imply no authentication, session or account-protection concern for the search feature. No security test type is warranted.
